site.title: Mountain Huts Map
site.tagline: Bivouacs and mountain huts across the Italian Alps and beyond

topo.borders: Dashed lines (including at sea): administrative borders between countries

hut.whoHasBeenHereComingSoon: Soon you'll be able to read and share experiences from people who've visited this place.

safety.disclaimer: Information on this site may be inaccurate or out of date. Always check weather conditions and opening status before you go: responsibility for the trip is the visitor's own.

about.title: About
about.intro: Mountain Huts Map brings alpine bivouacs and huts together on a single map, starting with the Italian Alps and the Bergen area of Norway, with the goal of eventually covering all of Europe.
about.noFakeDataBody: Elevation, coordinates, and prices are never invented: if a source doesn't report them, they're left blank (—) instead of being estimated. Every entry cites the sources its data comes from.
about.testPhaseBody: The site is currently in a testing phase with a small number of example huts, chosen to cover a variety of situations (bivouacs and huts, staffed and unstaffed, with and without photos). Real data at European scale is in progress.
about.contributeBody: The source code is public on GitHub: bug reports, fixes, and contributions are welcome.

attribution.title: Licenses and attribution
attribution.mapDataBody: Geographic data (location, elevation, facilities) mainly comes from OpenStreetMap, available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
attribution.tilesStandardBody: The standard map style is provided by OpenFreeMap, based on OpenStreetMap data.
attribution.tilesTopoBody: The topographic layer is provided by OpenTopoMap (CC-BY-SA). Its public service is meant for moderate traffic: under high traffic, switch to a paid or self-hosted provider.
attribution.libraryBody: The interactive map is built with MapLibre GL JS (BSD-3-Clause license).
attribution.photosBody: Photos come from Wikimedia Commons and other listed sources; each photo's author and license are shown on the corresponding hut's page.

attribution.seedDataNote: Note: the data currently published is a hand-entered test set (seed data) used to exercise the site, not an extraction from the sources listed above.
